title: coord.py dedup claims research keys from the question's own words, past the id pattern a claim key takes
goal: coord.py dedup claims a research:TOPIC:TERM key only in the FIELD_VALUE pattern claim keys take (BG-dn5n7z7k), each kb lacks term mapped to an id first, so no digest --key that overlaps research: prints a free-text term

run: import argparse, os, sys, tempfile, time; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import coord; coord.fingerprint = lambda q, t=None: ("logs/otel-python-sdk", ["batch size", "a+b (c)"]); s = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "c.sqlite"); b = coord.dedup(argparse.Namespace(store=s, holder="h", topic=None, token=None, ttl=60, question="q"), time.time); bad = [k for k in b["claimed"] if not coord.FIELD_VALUE.fullmatch(k)]; print("claimed:", b["claimed"], "past FIELD_VALUE:", bad); sys.exit(1 if bad or not b["claimed"] else 0)

clauses.clause: coord.py dedup claims a research:TOPIC:TERM key only in the FIELD_VALUE pattern claim keys take (BG-dn5n7z7k), each kb lacks term mapped to an id first, so no digest --key that overlaps research: prints a free-text term

notes: Planning 2026-10-23 on 35b5b7cb2: the repro was a placeholder (sys.exit(1)); it now plants lack terms with a space and punctuation through coord.dedup and exits 1 (both claimed keys fail FIELD_VALUE). It also needs the dedup to still claim, so a fix that drops every such term passes only if it maps them to ids. Found while fixing BG-dn5n7z7k, not fixed there since dedup keys need terms mapped to ids.
